payload.claim: The docstring says "A hunk of the diff from `head` to it is read first", i.e. from the packaged head to graded_head, implying the command `head..graded_head`. The actual code two lines below computes `f"{graded_head}..{head}"`, the reverse order. The reversal is deliberate (it is what puts the packaged head on the diff's new side, per the task's own notes on reading the reversed diff), but the docstring describes the opposite direction from what the code executes, which is exactly the kind of non-obvious ordering a future editor could get wrong by trusting the comment over the code.
